Chat Edit: 'Tasks: SkyNet Control & Auth Fixes
 Phase 1: Backend Auth Fixes
 Modify telegram_link_service.py to support anonymous tokens
 Update telegram_auth.py to use DB-backed tokens
 Update telegram_webhook.py for signup flow support
 Phase 2: System Data API
 Add /api/customer/system/summary to customer.py
 Add /api/customer/system/workflows to customer.py
 Phase 3: SkyNet UI Components
 Create SkyNetLayout.tsx (Scaffold)
 Create Sidebar.tsx (Navigation & Resource Monitor)
 Create SystemHealthWidget.tsx (Real-time Bars)
 Create ModelConfigWidget.tsx (Live Params)
 Create LiveFeed.tsx (Activity log)
 Create CapabilityCloud.tsx (Top bar tags)
 Phase 4: Dashboard Overhaul
 Refactor customer-dashboard.tsx to use modular SkyNet UI
 Implement 30s polling for health/quota data
 Phase 5: Verification
 Verify Telegram Linking flow (signup & signin)
 Verify Real-time data updates in SkyNet widgets
 Visual audit of the final dashboard
 test real end to end , production level '
